notes.title: The game is free now
notes.content:
As I wrote earlier the game is now free!
Those who bought the game earlier got a new free character with increased health pool and lightning as a starting weapon.

notes.title: The game will be free!
notes.content:
Hello.
I have decided to make the game free. This game was originally meant to be very simple and accessible, without a lot of difficult mechanics or anything else. The kind of game that everyone can get through.

I will add a new hero, for those who bought the game and it will be only for you.

If you have any suggestions, please share them.
